description.value: Kokanee Glacier Resort is a resort-motel situated just outside Nelson, BC on Highway 3A, offering suites with full kitchens, living rooms, and bedrooms for a comfortable multi-night stay. It serves as a basecamp for the Kootenays' outdoor offerings—mountain biking, hiking, fishing, hot springs, skiing, and golf at several nearby courses. The property has an on-site restaurant and partners with local activity operators to round out a touring itinerary.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address, phone number, and email. The site confirms an on-site restaurant ('Visit Kokanee Glacier Resort Restaurant Now!') and lists mountain biking as a featured activity, but contains no mention of bike storage, laundry, e-bike charging, or other cyclist-specific amenities. OSM's internet_access=wlan tag is not confirmed by the website text, so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active resort-motel with a functioning website, online booking, and confirmed contact details. Clearly useful to touring cyclists exploring the Nelson/Kootenays area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website also lists a toll-free number (877) 825-9420 not present in OSM tags. Mountain biking is listed as a featured activity, which may warrant a follow-up inquiry about bike-specific amenities.
